gloss_en: the supernal glory belonging to the supernal utterance — the exalted divine glory (kavod elyon) associated with the hidden/sealed utterance 'Bereishit' (the ma'amar satum), identified with the question 'Ayeh mekom kevodo' ('Where is the place of His glory?'), the concealed source from which vitality flows even to the filthy places (Likutey Moharan II:12)
